scripts.bundle_downloads_schema: pnpm --package=@apidevtools/swagger-cli dlx swagger-cli bundle galaxy_downloads.openapi.json -o galaxy_downloads.bundle.openapi.json
scripts.convert_openapi_to_json_schema: bash -c "pnpm --package=@openapi-contrib/openapi-schema-to-json-schema dlx openapi-schema-to-json-schema --input <(pnpm --package=@apidevtools/swagger-cli dlx swagger-cli bundle galaxy_downloads.openapi.json |cat <(pnpm dlx node-jq 'del(.definitions, .type, .items)' galaxy.schema.json) - |pnpm dlx node-jq -s add) --output galaxy.old.schema.json"
